question: Why does TypeScript reject this in React 19?
options: The arrow implicitly returns el, not a cleanup
say: Why does TypeScript reject this ref callback in React nineteen?
explanation: The parentheses make the arrow return el. Ref callbacks may only return a cleanup function, so use a block body: el => { box = el; }.
explainSay: It implicitly returns the element. Ref callbacks may only return a cleanup, so use curly braces.
